excerpts.author: phil_govegan
excerpts.content:
what are the next steps? 
If the 'happy world' test part has ended please give me green light to mess up with the setups (:

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content:
Definitely you can mess up as much as you want 😉 phase 1 testing is over.

We will release a summary for phase 1 this week. 
Next step is phase 2 which is a public testnet where anyone can join as an operator and anyone can run their own validator on the network by selecting operators from the network.
We aim for June! 
Very ambitious but we want to move fast before the merge happens

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: where/when can I start reading about joining this testnet as an operator?

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content:
You can run a local SSV network today, or if there are 2-3 other members here who wants to join we can have a 4 node network running a Pyrmont validator setup pretty quick.

For phase 2 we aim it for June

excerpts.content: thanks, but before joining any network, any document I should be reading? more than the specifications for SSV I mean the actual implementation
